name: The Forgotten Battlefield
description: The grass here is unnaturally long, hiding the rusted remains of spears and shields. This was the site of a great battle long ago.

discovery.message: The road passes through a wide, silent plain littered with the rusted metal of a past age.

the-field.text: The wind whistles through the rusted relics of war. You can see a partially collapsed war monument in the distance.

choices.label: [Charisma 12] Offer a moment of silence for the fallen.
Scavenge the field for anything useful.
Look for the ghost lilies Thistle described.
[Paladin] Perform the Rite of Rest at the broken monument.

leave.text: You leave the battlefield to the silence of the dead.

search-remains.text: You use your knowledge of military history to identify where the high-ranking officers might have fallen.
search-remains.success_text: You find a half-buried helm with the markings of the Royal Vanguard. Beneath it lies a fine blade.
search-remains.failure_text: You find only rusted scrap and bone fragments.

commander-loot.text: The longsword is still in remarkably good condition.

honor-fallen.text: A brief sense of peace settles over the field. You feel more connected to the history of these lands.

scavenge-field.text: As you pick through the debris, the ground begins to churn. A restless spirit rises from the earth!

scavenge-success.text: With the spirits laid to rest, you find a few loose coins and a dented shield.

lily-search.text: Thistle said they grow on the barrow mounds, where the most men fell. You walk the long grass looking for anything pale.
lily-search.success_text: On the far side of a sunken barrow, a ring of white flowers glows faintly in the grass, cold as frost.
lily-search.failure_text: Grass, rust and bone. If the lilies are here, you can't find them.

lily-again.text: The field is wide and the grass is long.

lily-barrow.text: As you kneel to pick them, the barrow shifts. Something under it does not want its flowers taken.

lily-pick.text: The dead lie still again. You pick the lilies carefully; they seem to dim in your hand.

rite-of-rest.text: You kneel at the foot of the broken monument and begin the words of rest. The wind drops. Somewhere in the grass, something starts to wail.
rite-of-rest.success_text: You hold the words through the wailing. Cold lights rise from the grass and come at you, furious, but the rite holds.
rite-of-rest.failure_text: The wailing gets inside your head and the words scatter. The lights sink back into the grass. You will have to begin again.

angry-dead.text: Three spirits tear free of the field, faces twisted, hands reaching for your throat.

at-rest.text: The last light thins to nothing. For the first time in a hundred years, the Forgotten Battlefield is quiet. Even the wind sounds gentler.
